sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-300M-1m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-300M-1m is the long-context (1M) checkpoint of the 300M CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs).
